newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Turkish premier signs Nigeria economic accord.
newsitem.headline: Turkish premier signs Nigeria economic accord.

text.p: Turkish prime-minister Necmettin Erbakan on Tuesday signed economic agreements with Nigeria's military government during the last step of a controversial African tour.
A joint statement after the signing said the two countries hoped to boost trade to an annual $500 million on each side from a current level of little over $1 million.

Erbakan and Nigeria's Chief of General Staff Lieutenant- General Oladipo Diya signed a trade agreement, a joint economic protocol, a maritime agreement and an agreement promoting and protecting investment between the two countries.
"This is a historic day and a happy one indeed because the agreements signed today have gone a long way to improve our relationship," Erbakan said after the signing.
Erbakan's trip to outcast states Nigeria and Libya has caused outrage among both a large section on Turkish public opinion and among its traditional western allies.
Nigeria has been shunned by the West for alleged human rights abuses and lack of democracy.
